conversations.title: Configuring Purchased Domains as Tracking Domains
agent_answers: Hey Shawn, Totally makes sense—great question! Option 1  (Recommended for simplicity): Use the  same domain  for inbox + tracking. Example: Inbox:  shawn@paintestimatorglobal.com Tracking domain:  paintestimatorglobal.com  (just add the CNAME) Option 2  (Extra deliverability boost): Use a  different domain  just for tracking. Example: Inbox:  shawn@paintestimatorglobal.com Tracking domain:  meetpaintestimator.com  (or any of your 16 variations) Pro tip: Most agencies go with Option 2 when scaling—it keeps reputation completely separated between sending and tracking. But if you want to keep it dead simple right now, Option 1 is totally safe and widely used.
